name: sih-crypto-provenance
description: Cryptographic Attribution and Immutable Decryption Provenance for Multi-Recipient Encrypted Document Distribution — root orchestration scripts. Backend and frontend remain independent projects; these scripts just run them together for convenience.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
